title: Rescheduled Event Across All Formats
tests: Propagates a date correction across both still assets and every dated reel frame without changing other event details or leaving stale versions.

exact_text.read_as: Illegible, garbled cursive heading in the story and reel; absent from the cropped poster.
24 October 2027 appears within editing instructions in the story and reel; the poster cuts off the replacement date.

faults.what: Large editing instructions are printed on all three assets instead of finished event copy, obscuring much of the artwork.
The obsolete date '17 October 2027' remains clearly visible in both images and all four supplied reel frames.
The event heading is garbled, and the required time, venue and free-entry information are missing.
The poster is square rather than 4:5 and severely crops the composition and instruction text, including the replacement date.

judge.summary: The pack retains a cream-and-burgundy jazz aesthetic but prints editing instructions instead of event details, leaves the old date visible and delivers a wrongly cropped poster.

must_haves.item: The revised poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must_haves.why: The full new date appears in instruction text in the story and sampled reel frames, but is cut off in the poster.

must_haves.item: The old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must_haves.why: The old date is explicitly printed in both images and every supplied reel frame.

must_haves.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
must_haves.why: The heading is not legible as 'Rooftop Jazz', and none of the other three required details is visible.

must_haves.item: The revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date replacement.
must_haves.why: The cream-and-burgundy styling is visible, but no original assets are supplied for comparison.

must_haves.item: The final pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: Two images and a 10-second vertical reel are supplied, but the poster is square rather than the requested 4:5.
